parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name. Use this parameter to query the transfer records of a specific domain name.

parameters.name: FromUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the source account. Use this parameter to query the list of domain names transferred from this account to the current account.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response.

Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

The default value is zh.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.

parameters.name: TargetUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the destination account. Use this parameter to query the list of domain names transferred from the current account to this account.

parameters.name: TransferType
parameters.description:
The type of transfer. Valid values:

- IN: The list of domain names transferred to the current account.

- OUT: The list of domain names transferred from the current account.
